top_candidates.original_title: Can we have the day off?
top_candidates.generated_headline: The Productivity Paradox: Why AI Won't Buy Us Free Time
top_candidates.summary: Historical and mathematical precedents show that productivity gains rarely translate to reduced working hours for employees. Instead, systemic competition (the prisoner's dilemma of work culture) and shareholder alignment ensure that increased output merely raises the baseline expectation, filtering benefits upward rather than returning time to the workers. Quote: We were told 'computers will save you so much time on work tasks that you won't even know what to do with your free time'. I spent the next 30 years working the same number of hours.
